correctness.rationale: All 1,048,575 nonzero quaternary binary cubic forms are partitioned into 141 complete GL4(F2) orbits using elementary generators. Four-chart exact Groebner unit-ideal tests yield 36 geometric-smooth orbits of total 322,560. For each, formal first derivatives and rational-point evaluation give a finite partition preserved under the coordinate group. An independent monomial-by-monomial derivative evaluator reproduces all smooth representative partitions and the 14-bin weighted totals. The independent evaluator does not redo orbit or smoothness verification; that limit is explicit.

value.rationale: The Gauss-map fiber profile counts repeated rational tangent hyperplanes, a canonical dual-projective arithmetic incidence invariant. The complete census covers every smooth binary cubic form, finds fourteen nontrivial multiplicity types with exact counts, and distinguishes surfaces not separable by published rational point/line/Eckardt/double-point invariants. It is a motivated finite-field tangency classification, not a selected arbitrary parameter slice.
